title: (RHBA-2014:0276) devtoolset-2-eclipse bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated devtoolset-2-eclipse packages that fix several bugs and add various
enhancements are now available for Red Hat Developer Toolset 2.1.
portal_synopsis: devtoolset-2-eclipse bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Workstation)|Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Workstation)|2|x86_64
Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Server)|Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Server)|2|x86_64
Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Server)|Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Server)|2|i386
Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Workstation)|Red Hat Developer Toolset (for RHEL Workstation)|2|i386
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red
Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/site/articles/11258
portal_description:
The Eclipse platform is designed for building integrated development
environments (IDEs), server-side applications, desktop applications, and
everything in between. The devtoolset-2-eclipse packages provide the Red Hat
Developer Toolset version of Eclipse.

The devtoolset-2-eclipse packages have been upgraded to version 4.3.1, which
provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version.
Particularly, the Eclipse platform and plug-ins (CDT, Linux Tools, EGit/JGit,
RSE, Mylyn) have been upgraded to Kepler Service Release 1. (BZ#1015996)

In addition, this update adds the following enhancement:

* A preference page has been added to Eclipse, which allows users to select
between the Red Hat Enterprise Linux base or the Developer Toolset version of
the profiling tools; namely, the valgrind, oprofile, and systemtap packages.
(BZ#1027331)

Users of devtoolset-2-eclipse are advised to upgrade to these updated packages,
which fix these bugs and add these enhancements.
